Learners can read two short Korean one-room listings and, for each room, find and compare four things: the deposit and monthly rent (for example, 보증금 1000/월세 50 means a 10,000,000 won deposit and 500,000 won a month), the maintenance fee and what it includes or excludes (관리비 별도, 인터넷·수도 포함), the built-in items (풀옵션: 에어컨, 세탁기, 냉장고), and the move-in date (즉시 입주, 10월 말 입주 가능).
fixes.after: Learners can read two short one-room listings and compare deposit and rent (보증금 1000/월세 50), maintenance fees (관리비 별도, 포함), built-in items (풀옵션), and move-in dates (즉시 입주, 10월 말 입주 가능).

fixes.problem: "Barang bawaan" means things someone brings with them, like belongings or luggage. That is not what "built-in items" means, and it contradicts the gloss in brackets. The phrase should just be "fasilitas terpasang".
fixes.fix: Linh, seorang mahasiswi asal Vietnam yang akan meninggalkan asramanya pada akhir Oktober, membandingkan dua iklan kamar one-room berdasarkan biaya, fasilitas terpasang, dan tanggal pindah.

fixes.problem: "dormitorio" means 'bedroom' in Spanish, not a student dorm (residence hall).
fixes.fix: Linh, una estudiante vietnamita que deja su residencia estudiantil a finales de octubre, compara dos anuncios de habitaciones (one-room) según el precio, los artículos incluidos y la fecha de mudanza.

fixes.problem: The English says "contact me", but the translation drops "me". It has no "comigo", so it no longer says who to contact.
fixes.fix: Se houver algum problema, entre em contato comigo imediatamente.

fixes.problem: "wones" is not the usual Brazilian Portuguese plural of "won". The usual form is "wons".
fixes.fix: Escreva os valores em wons: 앱에서 본 방의 '보증금 1000/월세 50'을 원 단위로 바꿔 쓰세요.

fixes.problem: "by the 25th" includes the 25th as the last possible day; "avant le 25" strictly means before the 25th, which changes the deadline.
fixes.fix: Vous pouvez payer les charges au plus tard le 25 de chaque mois.

fixes.problem: "dormitorio" means "bedroom" in Spanish. The English "dorm" is a student residence ("residencia estudiantil"), so the meaning changes.
fixes.fix: Linh, una estudiante vietnamita que deja su residencia estudiantil a finales de octubre, compara dos anuncios de habitaciones (one-room) según el costo, los artículos incluidos y la fecha de mudanza.

fixes.problem: 'wones' is the Spanish plural of 'won'. Brazilian Portuguese uses 'wons'.
